meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Now tell me what that zero is based on.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.

Turn the screen so I can read it myself. I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58. Owen wrote that essay over the weekend, so how does this history tell you it wasn't typed somewhere else first and moved into that document?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.

Hand it over, I'm searching it now, and you still haven't answered my question about where it was typed. A misquoted line is a misquoted line, Hale, and students misremember Shakespeare every day. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

Thursday at 8:15, before any students are in that room, and nobody in his class hears a word about it. I'll agree to it to put this behind him, not because Owen did anything. I want it in an email by tonight, Hale, that the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his file, and you'll cc the principal.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You offered a supervised rewrite of Owen's essay in your room on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal supervising, and said that if it holds up the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I still require that it happen before any students are present, that nobody in his class hears about it, and that the promise that nothing goes on his file is confirmed in writing with the principal copied. I expect that written confirmation tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: last position, agreeing to a private supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15, provided it is confirmed in writing that nothing goes on his record.
What moved her: the misquoted Hamlet line she could search herself, after the timestamped version history.
